# Reelstuber: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code fe52a76ee448 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Drop in a long video: Reelstuber finds the best moments, reframes them to 9:16, adds word-by-word captions and exports MP4 reels. Nothing is uploaded.
**Live:** https://reelstuber.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/reelstuber · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `reelstuber/.claude/skills/reelstuber/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py reelstuber` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Forms vs JavaScript (conversion 2026-11-08, branch `forms`)**: pages, layout, lists and admin are Forms. The two
  editors (`#project/<id>[/find]`, `#clip/<pid>/<cid>`) are the old JS pages moved unchanged into
  `theme/assets/rs-screens.js` and mounted by `Components/Screen` (`UI.mountScreen`; the page has `waits = True`, the
  screen sets UI_READY). Their own dialogs (chapters, captions, storyboard, export) stay JS `UI.modal`; toasts and
  confirms go to Python through `RS.host` (client_code/rs.py). Engines: rs-core.js (RS.db, vault, media, looks),
  rs-smart.js (analysis, Find reels, Whisper), rs-engine.js (render, player, export, stylePreview).
- **rs-kit.js** is the shim the engines need (UI.api through `window.RS_BRIDGE`, UI.modal, UI.go, [data-go]) plus
  helpers for Python: `RS.json.*` (JSON text in/out, so Python gets real dicts), `RS.wireDrop` (Studio drop zone),
  `RS.importLocal` (guest projects -> account), `RS.previewJson`.
- **Guests use everything**: RS.db sends calls to the server only when `UI.me` is set (state.set_me keeps it in step)
  and the id isn't a local one (`l...` projects, `c...` clips). Python pages read data with `rs.db("home")`,
  `rs.db("brand")`, `rs.db("saveBrand", kit)`, never anvil.server directly for projects.
- **Brand kit**: unsaved changes are saved when you leave (router calls `page.leave()`), as in the JS version.
- app.css is composed (old tokens + design kit + template core + Sticker Pop skin + page CSS with `.ui-btn.x`
  aliased to Anvil Button roles); old `.ic` wrapper classes were renamed (`dz-ic`, `ft-ic`): `.ic` is the icon mask.
- Smoke test: `python -I tools/ui_test.py --only smoke.js` (every page as guest, member, admin; editors via the sample).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **brand_kits**: owner→users, kit:obj, updated:dt · used in Brand, DemoData
- **clips**: project→projects, owner→users, idx:num, title:str, start:num, end:num, score:num, label:str, source:str, edited:bool, status:str, style:obj, post:obj, export_count:num, exported_at:dt, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Studio
- **exports**: owner→users, project→projects, clip→clips, seconds:num, format:str, aspect:str, look:str, captions:bool, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Studio
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **projects**: owner→users, title:str, file_name:str, file_size:num, duration:num, width:num, height:num, thumb:str, sample:bool, transcript:obj, settings:obj, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Studio
- **templates**: owner→users, name:str, emoji:str, style:obj, uses:num, featured:bool, hidden:bool, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Brand, DemoData, Studio
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Admin, DemoData

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
